result:
Perfect! I've set up auto-running tests on file changes. Here's what the hook does:

**Configuration:**
- **Trigger:** Runs whenever you edit or write a TypeScript/JavaScript file (`.ts`, `.js`, `.mjs`, `.cjs`)
- **Action:** Automatically runs `npm test` (which runs xo linting + ava tests + type checking)
- **Behavior:** 
  - Runs async in the background, so it doesn't block your work
  - Shows "Running tests..." status while it runs
  - Times out after 2 minutes if tests hang
  - Only triggers on code files, not other document types

Now when you edit any source file, tests will re-run automatically without you having to switch windows. The results will be shown in the status line.

If you want to disable it later, use `/hooks` to view and toggle it.
